mechanism_narrative: A lower current industrial production level (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is below 100 (2017=100), SPX forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in industrial production signals a deepening economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a recessionary scenario.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE > 3.5 and INDPRO < 103 fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed's rate hikes exacerbate economic weakness.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), SPX forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a higher current level of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as inflation fears lead to higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), SPX forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 300 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1300 thousand units signals reduced residential construction activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the housing sector slowdown weighs on consumer confidence and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it signals reduced consumer spending that typically leads to lower corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is below 700,000 million dollars, SPX forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as higher short-term rates compress equity valuations and increase borrowing costs for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
